summary: Selected r1b2 as the strongest eligible completed research world. Its committed candidate 3d4967ddb5d76dce1f021ca6975ee2125a7cd53d contains only system/** changes and passes the implementation-boundary audit. The source reads the curated train and public-validation files only, uses train-only vocabularies and the five official fields, and imports the pinned starter evaluator; no hidden/test input references were found. Matched pointwise controls and corrected within-user BPR runs are preserved as raw JSON traces. BPR improved both GAUC and nDCG@5 in two seeds: seed 0 primary 0.603758 versus 0.601470 control, and seed 1 primary 0.603440 versus 0.601761 control; the paired mean gain is 0.001984. This is meaningful public-validation progress and reduces uncertainty about the tested objective mismatch, while the two-seed evidence does not establish hidden-test generalization. The preserved reversed-gradient run is a useful falsified implementation diagnostic, not a claimed model result. No branch State metadata was created or required.
